hypothesis.statement: On a real eyes-closed posterior EEG channel (eegmmidb S002R02, POz), the newly-authored renyiEntropy reproduces NeuroKit2 entropy_renyi BIT-FOR-BIT across alpha = {0.5, 1, 2, 3} on the identical amplitude histogram; the alpha=1 value equals the Shannon entropy, and the family is non-increasing in alpha.

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), channel POz (posterior), first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples)

decision.threshold: descriptive: renyiEntropy equals NeuroKit2 entropy_renyi to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9) across the alpha family, AND H_alpha is non-increasing in alpha
